claims.claim: EU Regulation 2023/956 establishes the CBAM, covering steel, aluminium, cement, fertilisers, hydrogen, and electricity.

sources.name: EU Regulation 2023/956 establishing CBAM
supports: Establishes CBAM legal basis, covered goods, and certificate obligation.
limits: Legal text defines the framework; actual enforcement depends on national implementation.

claims.claim: The CBAM transitional phase requires EU importers to submit quarterly embedded-carbon reports from Q4 2023 through end of 2025.

sources.name: EU Implementing Regulation 2023/1773 (CBAM transitional reporting)
supports: Specifies transitional-period reporting obligations, format, and quarterly deadlines.
limits: Covers transitional phase only; definitive-phase certificate mechanics are in Reg. 2023/956.

claims.claim: From 1 January 2026, EU importers must surrender CBAM certificates equal to the embedded carbon in covered imports, priced at the EU ETS carbon price.

sources.name: EU Regulation 2023/956 establishing CBAM
supports: Article 22 and related provisions define the certificate-purchase obligation and ETS-price linkage.
limits: ETS price is variable; actual certificate cost cannot be predicted from the regulation alone.

sources.name: European Commission CBAM guidance
supports: Confirms 2026 definitive phase start and certificate mechanism.
limits: Guidance may lag regulatory amendments; check for updates.

claims.claim: Non-EU exporters without verified carbon pricing data in their home jurisdiction face higher effective CBAM certificate costs.

sources.name: European Commission CBAM guidance
supports: Explains deduction mechanism: importers may offset carbon prices already paid in country of origin.
limits: Does not quantify cost differential for specific non-EU jurisdictions; requires case-by-case assessment.

sources.name: European Parliament CBAM briefing
supports: Explains competitive-impact rationale and differential effect on exporters with no home carbon price.
limits: Briefing predates final Regulation text; some details may differ from enacted version.

claims.claim: Exact CBAM certificate prices for 2026 and beyond cannot be determined in advance.

sources.name: EU Regulation 2023/956 establishing CBAM
supports: Certificate price is defined as the weekly average EU ETS auction price, which fluctuates.
limits: ETS price forecasting is outside the scope of the regulation.

unsupported_claims: Specific CBAM certificate price levels for 2026–2030 (depends on EU ETS market).
Per-country compliance rate or registration volumes in the CBAM registry.
